title: Batch 161 — eight in-place Hebrew source enrichments and four duplicate-family reconciliations
review_method: Manual public web/open inspection of eight Hebrew source bodies at new, distinct passages. All eight identities already existed; each received one additional non-verbatim, source-grounded research proposition. No title, index, search snippet or scan was used as content evidence. No crawler retry, access-control bypass or full-text reproduction.
metrics_note: Prior PR workspace run 44316981754 measured 1530/854/3941 after batch160; this was not public main. The recorded batch160 planning boundary is 1530/854/3943. This run also normalizes four duplicate AID presentations to one Evidence Family and updates reconciliation to merge same-family propositions; full-index actual metrics must be regenerated. Batch161 adds eight in-place propositions and no new identities or Verified items; 1530/854/3951 is a planning boundary only.

deduplication_check.note: Eight enrichment AIDs were matched to existing canonical records; no new identity was created. Four repeated AID presentations (3318017, 4772806, 4304430, 2989348) were linked to one Evidence Family each. Full-index scan pending.
